_comment: THE canonical list of modules and submodules a role can be granted.
The Roles screen draws itself from this file, the menu and route guard read it,
and the server enforces against it. frontend/src/app/services/permission-tree.json
is a copy of this file; backend/accounts/tests_permission_tree.py asserts the two
are identical, so they cannot drift again.
key      what is stored in Role.permissions
label    what the Roles screen shows
help     one line saying what the grant lets a person do (shown under the label)
route    the page it opens (a module's page, or an Admin sub-page)
verbs    which of read/create/update/delete mean something here. Left out = all four.
A report has only 'read'; offering Add/Edit/Delete on it was noise.
actions  extra ticks (Cancel a bill, Lock payroll...) granted one by one
A role that can Add, Edit or Delete, or holds an action tick, can always View
(the server makes that so when a role is saved).
'legacy_aliases' maps keys that older saved roles used to the keys they now mean.
